LESSON: FAMILY UNITY

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.4: Family Unity

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Family Unity
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is family unity important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the importance of family unity
2. identify challenges faced by families today

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: describe the importance of family unity

• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Try this

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: identify challenges faced by families today

• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “identify challenges faced by families today” using a home/county example.

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: describe the importance of family unity
• Model 2: identify challenges faced by families today

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe the importance of family unity
2. Practise: identify challenges faced by families today

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Family Unity.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is family unity important?
2. How can family unity be maintained?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe the importance of family unity
